intro: Every person at CCC was invited to take a real step in three areas.
caption: Everyone engaged. Everyone reaching **one more**.

cards.title: Personal Witness
cards.text: Who in your sphere of influence is God inviting you to reach? Name your one more, pray for them daily, and share your story.

cards.title: Faith
cards.text: What step will move you out of your comfort zone and into deeper dependence on God?

cards.title: Generosity
cards.text: How can you grow in giving as an expression of gratitude for what God has already given you?
